name: vibe-canvas-extensions
description: Build tooling for the vibe Agent Canvas extensions.
comment: Dependencies live here, one level ABOVE each extension package root: installing an extension from a local path copies that directory verbatim, so a node_modules inside vibe-board/ would land in the agent-server install (38 MB of build-only deps).

scripts.validate: npm run build && node validate-extension.mjs vibe-board
